question: In February 2025, an avalanche struck a Border Roads Organisation camp in which location, resulting in eight fatalities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mana, Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In February 2025, an avalanche struck a Border Roads Organisation (BRO) camp in **Mana, Uttarakhand**, causing the tragic loss of eight lives.
 
• **Mana** is the last Indian village near the Indo-China border in Uttarakhand, situated in the Chamoli district.
 
• The **Border Roads Organisation (BRO)** is responsible for developing and maintaining road networks in border areas, which often involves operating in challenging terrains like Mana.
 
• The avalanche occurred due to heavy snowfall and unstable weather conditions in the Himalayan region, which are common during the winter months.
 
• Natural disasters like avalanches are frequent in Himalayan regions, necessitating advanced disaster management and preparedness by organizations like BRO.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Avalanche:**

 
 
• An avalanche is a sudden flow of snow down a slope, triggered by factors like weather changes, vibrations, or human activity.
 
• The Himalayan region is highly prone to avalanches due to its steep slopes, heavy snowfall, and changing climatic conditions.
 
 
 
• **Border Roads Organisation (BRO):**
 
 
• The BRO was established in **1960** to construct and maintain road infrastructure in India's border areas.
 
• It plays a crucial role in supporting India's armed forces and ensuring connectivity in remote regions.
 
 
 
• **Mana Village:**
 
 
• Mana is located at an altitude of approximately 3,200 meters above sea level, making it prone to extreme weather conditions.
 
• The village is a popular tourist destination and serves as a gateway to the famous **Badrinath Temple**.
 
 
 
• **Disaster Preparedness:**
 
 
• India has implemented initiatives like the **National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)** to improve disaster response and mitigation.
 
• Advanced technologies, such as avalanche forecasting systems, are being adopted to enhance preparedness in high-risk areas.
